item.title: This startup wants to bring Bitcoin to Africans who can’t afford the Internet
item.description: Machankura allows people to send and receive Bitcoin using USSD technology, the same system Africans use to check airtime, transfer mobile money, or query their account balance in traditional banking.

item.title: MultiChoice to shut down Showmax after 11 years as Canal+ cuts costs
item.description: The streaming service will be wound down in the coming months, although the company has not provided a final closure date as legal processes tied to the acquisition continue to be finalised.

item.title: Bolt and WANATU beat South Africa’s licence deadline. Their drivers may not.
item.description: Bolt said it received its Certificate of Registration from the National Public Transport Regulator (NPTR) on February 27.

item.title: Nigeria’s loan apps are pulling back from the small loans that built them
item.description: Nigeria’s digital lending boom was built on small, instant loans between ₦5,000 ($3.61) and ₦10,000 ($7.21) disbursed within minutes on sleek apps. But that model is beginning to change.

item.title: Cybercrime costs Africa $10 billion a year. AI is about to make that number bigger.
item.description: The HP Wolf Security Threat Insights Report, released by the security unit of technology manufacturer HP Inc, shows attackers shifting from carefully engineered exploits toward a strategy built on speed and volume.

item.title: Google’s AI search now works in Yoruba and Hausa for Nigerian users
